glosses: on the basis of; by the standard of
patterns.usage_note: Names the criterion a judgment or decision rests on, or the quality the actor brings to bear as its measure (所定の基準をもって判定する, 過半数をもって可決する, 誠意をもって対応する). The sibling entries mark the point at which something takes effect or ends (本日をもって閉店) and the medium an act travels through (書面をもって). It belongs to formal notices and ceremonial speech; で is the ordinary equivalent in the criterion use (過半数で可決する).

examples.ruby: 合否[ごうひ]は所定[しょてい]の基準[きじゅん]をもって判定[はんてい]いたします。
examples.english: Pass or fail is determined against the prescribed standard.

examples.ruby: 議案[ぎあん]は過半数[かはんすう]の賛成[さんせい]をもって可決[かけつ]された。
examples.english: The motion was passed with a majority in favor.

examples.ruby: 弊社[へいしゃ]は誠意[せいい]をもって対応[たいおう]いたします。
examples.english: We will handle the matter in good faith.

glosses: on the basis of; going by
patterns.usage_note: Names the criterion or measure by which something is decided, judged or reckoned: 多数決でもって可決する, 成績でもって決まる, with the predicate reporting a decision or its outcome. Two sibling entries take the other readings: the instrument or material an action uses (お金でもって, 竹と紙でもって) and the quality the actor brings (経験でもって, 意志でもって). For a cut-off in time, 本日をもって閉店 takes をもって rather than this form.

examples.ruby: その案[あん]は多数決[たすうけつ]でもって承認[しょうにん]された。
examples.english: The proposal was approved on the basis of a majority vote.

examples.ruby: クラス替[が]えは前期[ぜんき]の成績[せいせき]でもって決[き]まるそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently the new class assignments are decided by first-term grades.

examples.ruby: 審査員[しんさいん]は独自[どくじ]の基準[きじゅん]でもって作品[さくひん]を評価[ひょうか]した。
examples.english: The judges rated the entries by a standard of their own.

patterns.usage_note: Names the rate, price or standard something is reckoned or settled by: 時給千円で働く, 半額で買う, 多数決で決める. Sibling で entries: means, material or cause (筆で書く, メールで送る, 風邪で休む), place of an action (カフェで勉強する), group as doer (会社で), copula linking form (休みで), te-form joint (呼んで). The heavier をもって and でもって carry this same standard reading in formal writing.

examples.ruby: 時給[じきゅう]千円[せんえん]でアルバイトを始[はじ]めた。
examples.english: I took a part-time job at a thousand yen an hour.

examples.ruby: あの店[みせ]の服[ふく]は今[いま]なら半額[はんがく]で買[か]えるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear you can get the clothes at that shop for half price right now.

examples.ruby: クラスの代表[だいひょう]を多数決[たすうけつ]で選[えら]んだ。
examples.english: We picked our class representative by majority vote.
